# M3-2: Guardrails, rules, candidates

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-2`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-2`
- Depends on: M3-1b
- Touches (exclusive while running): classify/
- Plan refs: §3.2 steps 1-2, §3.3 interface and category targets, R6a, spikes/jev.md §Impact, STATE Decisions 2026-10-27
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
`classify/` holds the §3.3 types, the guardrails, the unanimous payee rules, and the candidate list drawn from the active plan's
existing categories.

## Scope
- The §3.3 types verbatim: `Txn`, `Candidate`, `Prediction`, `Model`.
- Guardrails: port from the old `categorizer/` (`git show b2414be:categorizer/categorizer.go`, with its tests). Skip transfers and
  CC payments, P2P, existing splits, unapproved rows already in `Inflow: Ready to Assign`, and locked rows. The P2P detector can't be a
  substring match on "Venmo" (§3.2): use account, payee-shape and memo signals, with fixture cases.
- Rules: a payee whose labels are unanimous across at least 3 examples (`LabeledHistory`, normalized payee) decides; the category must
  be in the active list. `Txn.PayeeHistory` uses the same data, newest first, last N, filtered to active candidates.
- Candidates (`store.CategoriesWithGroups`): the active plan's existing categories, minus deleted or hidden categories, categories in a deleted or hidden group, internal ones, `Inflow: Ready to Assign`, the `Credit Card Payments` group, and set-aside categories.
- Embedded `classify/policy.json`: excluded set-aside names (Birthday, Trip, Christmas, Giving and any like them in the plan), description
  overrides including the `Discretionary` policy. `PolicyHash` and `CandidatesHash` (sorted names + descriptions).
- A name in the policy that isn't in the plan is ignored with a warning, never created. Nothing renames or creates YNAB categories.

## Out of scope
- Model calls (M3-3, M3-4), the pipeline (M3-11), the PROPOSED simplified list (M4).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Ported guardrail tests pass, plus a case for each §3.2 skip.
- [ ] Test: P2P fixtures with no "Venmo" in the payee are skipped; a merchant containing a P2P-like word is not.
- [ ] Test: a rule needs unanimity and the minimum count; one dissenting label stops it; an out-of-list category stops it.
- [ ] Test: set-asides, internal, deleted, hidden, hidden-group and Credit Card Payments categories aren't candidates; a policy entry for a missing category warns.
- [ ] Test: `PayeeHistory` leaves out labels that aren't active candidates.
- [ ] Test: both hashes are order-independent and change when a name or description changes.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

- agy low: `store.CategoryWithGroup` omits the `internal` flags of category and group (`store/mirror_read.go:12-33`). If M3-2 needs them to drop internal categories from candidates, add them in `store/` only if this task touches store; otherwise filter by the existing fields and note it.

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `classify/types.go`: §3.3 `Txn`, `Candidate`, `Prediction`, `Model` verbatim.
  - `classify/guard.go`, `classify/p2p.go`: `Guard(Row) Skip` for transfers, CC/debt payments (Credit Card Payments group,
    debt `payment` type, payee shape by account type), P2P, splits (live children or an unmirrored sentinel category),
    unapproved Ready to Assign rows, locked rows (any human lock), and no payee + no memo. P2P = whole-word service
    descriptors (Zelle, Cash App, Square Cash, Apple Cash, PayPal only with a transfer word), or a person-shaped payee plus a
    wallet account or a P2P memo (service name, P2P phrase, emoji-only).
  - `classify/rules.go`: `NewRules(LabeledHistory, cands)`, `Decide` (unanimous, ≥`RuleMinExamples`=3, candidate only),
    `PayeeHistory` (newest first, candidates only, last N; `HistoryLen`=5), `NewTxn(TransactionDetail)`, `PayeeName`.
  - `classify/candidates.go`: `Candidates(CategoriesWithGroups, Policy) CandidateSet{Candidates, SetAsides, Warnings}`.
    `SetAsides` is meant for `LabeledHistory`'s excludedNames.
  - `classify/policy.go` + embedded `classify/policy.json`: set-aside keywords (whole word or +"s": Birthday, Christmas,
    Gift, Giving, Holiday, Trip, Vacation), description overrides (Discretionary), `PolicyHash`, `CandidatesHash`.
- Acceptance:
  - Ported guardrail tests + one per §3.2 skip → pass (`go test ./classify -run 'TestGuard|TestPayeeName'`)
  - P2P fixtures without "Venmo", merchants with P2P-like words → pass (`-run TestGuard_P2P`)
  - Rule unanimity / minimum / dissent / out-of-list → pass (`-run TestRules_`)
  - Candidate exclusions + missing-policy warnings → pass (`-run TestCandidates_`)
  - PayeeHistory filters non-candidates → pass (`-run TestPayeeHistory`)
  - Hashes order-independent and change on name/description → pass (`-run 'Hash'`)
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → pass
- Deviations from brief:
  - Internal categories are filtered by group name `Internal Master Category` plus YNAB's internal names, since
    `store.CategoryWithGroup` has no internal flag (per sup note; store untouched).
  - Set-asides are keyword-matched ("and any like them in the plan"), not exact names; the live names are e.g.
    "Holiday - Christmas", "Fun - Next Trip". Added Gift, Holiday, Vacation to the four named. Unmatched keywords warn.
  - The Discretionary description is the M0 spike's measured text plus one sentence that event spending goes there
    (2026-10-27 decision), since set-asides are no longer targets. This text was not what Jev was measured on: re-measure
    at calibration (PolicyHash keys it).
  - `CandidatesHash` also covers the group (the model sees it), a superset of names + descriptions.
  - Any human lock skips the row (only the `category` field exists today).

  - Optional: add `Internal` (and original group) to `store.CategoryWithGroup` and switch `isInternal` to it.
  - Brendan to confirm the set-aside keyword list and the Discretionary wording against the live plan.
